_readme: The community profile pool. One file per vehicle, fetched by
A profile here is COMMUNITY DATA. Its checksum proves the file is
intact; it proves nothing about whether its author was right. Fetching
shows you what would change and stops -- applying is a separate act.
To contribute: `omacar profile share <slug>`, then open a pull request
saying which car you ran it on and which entries you checked against

profiles.note: Not a car. The emulator `omacar bench start` runs, so the whole tool -- learned readings and the actuator path included -- can be exercised on a desk. Validated against the emulator's source.
